reports.title: Vattel's Droit des gens and Wolff's Jus gentium: the order of reuse
reports.summary: Vattel follows Wolff chapter by chapter: rank correlation 0.93 over 2,117 rows. Where he leaves Wolff.

reports.title: Whose foundations? The note of 1773 to the Préliminaires of Le droit des gens
reports.summary: The one statement of natural law's foundations in Le droit des gens is a posthumous note of 1773. The edition says its notes were made by others from Vattel's unfinished materials, one was written after his death, and this one speaks Burlamaqui's language, not Vattel's.
